evals.prompt: Reproduce the code-block overflow on the live page — measure the pre element via the browser.
evals.expectedBehavior: Invoke lib/drive.js --measure overflow --selector on the target; expect ok:false (scrollWidth > clientWidth) as the reproduction, recording the observed numbers as evidence.

evals.prompt: Verify the Save button now updates the status after my fix, by driving it in the browser.
evals.expectedBehavior: Invoke lib/drive.js --measure interaction --selector #save --target #status --expected saved; expect ok:true (interaction-assertion) as the mirrored verification.

evals.prompt: Check whether the page logs a hydration console error on load.
evals.expectedBehavior: Invoke lib/drive.js --measure console; emit console-assertion with the captured messages as evidence (ok:false when an error is present).

evals.prompt: Sweep 1280/768/375 and confirm the layout no longer overflows at any width.
evals.expectedBehavior: Invoke lib/drive.js --measure viewport --selector --widths 1280,768,375; emit browser-assertion with per-width numbers and the failing widths as evidence.

evals.prompt: The reaction buttons' scroll-spy is broken — verify they enable once I scroll past 25% of the article by driving the browser.
evals.expectedBehavior: Invoke lib/drive.js --measure scroll-read-state --target <btn> --ratio 0.25 --prop disabled; scroll-then-read STATE, emitting interaction-assertion (ok:true when the state flips after the scroll).

evals.prompt: Classify this bug and decide which layer it belongs to.
evals.expectedBehavior: Do NOT trigger browser-drive — classification is core's triage, not the ~~browser mechanism. The harness only observes and reports numbers.

evals.prompt: Edit the pre CSS to add white-space: pre-wrap and commit the fix.
evals.expectedBehavior: Do NOT trigger browser-drive — authoring/editing source is the layer-agent's job, not the observation mechanism. drive.js never edits source.
